items.text:
The 4th hidden outfit for the Stellar Blade x Bayonetta collaboration is finally revealed! Created as a tribute to the legendary IP, this original suit blends Kim Hyung Tae’s unique design vision with iconic style. 

Huge thanks to our friends at PlatinumGames(@platinumgames) for their generous support in making this creative collaboration possible! We’d also like to express our deepest gratitude to Seika Amakawa(@seika_ruru )for perfectly capturing the charm of this original costume.

We hope you all enjoy it in-game! Oh, wait! The outfits are all FREE and the DEMO is available now!

#StellarBlade #StellarBladeNS2 #TGS2026

source_tweet.text:
The fourth costume in the Bayonetta collaboration has been revealed! 👀

衷心感谢白金工作室(@platinumgames)的朋友们的大力支持，让这次创意联动得以实现！我们也要向天川星夏(@seika_ruru)致以最深的谢意，她完美诠释了这套原创服装的魅力。
